shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- skill ---'; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json; printf '\\n--- routing ---\\n'; sed -n '1,80p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/index.css vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- setup ---'; rg -n -C 8 \"Required setup|import '@gravity-ui/uikit/styles|ThemeProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -120; printf '%s\\n' '--- TextInput ---'; rg -n -C 5 \"value|onChange|type=|placeholder|label\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md | head -100; printf '%s\\n' '--- PasswordInput ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Checkbox ---'; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Checkbox.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Button ---'; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "onUpdate|onChange|AdaptiveProp|type Flex" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/index.d.ts | head -40; rg -n -C 3 "interface Flex|type Flex" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/*.d.ts | head -80; rg -n -C 3 "direction.*column|type.*direction" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/*.d.ts | head -80'
/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head; rg -n \"onUpdate|onChange|AdaptiveProp|interface Flex|type Flex\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.dependencies, null, 2))\"; sed -n '1,80p' src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx"
